question: Are source specimens and same-strand fractions available for all eight fixed flanking CpGs?
decision: Verify native values, original specimen identities, clocks, arms and array availability for owner review.
strongest_rival: Inconsistent strand choice, small-sample variation, baseline differences, epithelium enrichment versus whole tissue, distinct DSS schedules/vehicles, collection clocks and platforms can alter apparent recurrence.
discriminator: Verify the interrogated cytosine and original source string for each tissue mouse; use the already qualified external availability flags without opening its beta matrix.
exposure_record: Owner reviewed earlier Nagaraja and external evidence at 13ff486. Sources, original coverage and regional effects were seen, including numeric reads for availability/range. Native 48 same-strand values are part of Step 1 verification. External site effects, matched sign results and omission effects have not been computed or inspected before this freeze.
biological_unit: An individual mouse in one of two separate studies. Three mice per arm per study. The same animals contribute multiple CpGs; five fragments group the eight sites.
nesting_and_overlap: Two separate cohorts, no matched individuals. Stage 1 source slices and earlier qualification are reused. Sites and fragments are not independent mouse replicates.
population_and_selection: Exactly eight prior probe IDs at three left and five right flank dyads. Six specified GSE283386 saline mice (3 DSS, 3 water) and six GSE316762 DMSO mice (3 recovered, 3 healthy).
contrast: Verify presence, source-scale native fractions and independent sample identities only.
endpoint: 12 specimens and 48 same-strand tissue fractions with source addresses; fixed previous array availability.
methods: Restrict previous assay/sample crosswalks to the specified specimens, check GEO metadata/availability, map each probe onto its interrogated native base, and record exactly one deposited fraction per site/mouse. No group means or array outcome data.
missingness_and_exclusions: Accept zero and preserve exact deposited decimals. Halt for provenance review if an expected specimen/coordinate is duplicated or unavailable. No replacements or outcomes-driven filtering.
multiplicity: Eight fixed site descriptions. No p-value threshold, ranking, pooled effect, gene inference or independent-site test.
precision_basis: Three mice per arm, without an established material effect margin. Within-arm ranges and exhaustive one-mouse omissions assess finite-sample influence and are not confidence bounds.
interpretation_limit: Limited recurrence screen in two preparations and clocks. No adjudication of tissue-specific biology, causal regulation, late maintenance, gene targeting or relevance to all 63 amplicons.
stop_rule: Stop after Step 1 registration and preflight for owner review.
amendment_reason: Owner requested the saline-only fixed-site follow-up after the external feasibility closeout; preserve the preceding qualification.
